282:t_2:16.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The fact that they even assimilated $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ means organic, inorganic, it's all the same to them, huh.」

282:t_2:18.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「...At this point, we cannot classify the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ as $$バアル$$. However, it is a fact that they are just as dangerous.」

282:t_2:19.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Their erosion attacks also damage the pilot. A pilot who loses consciousness from an attack will simply become their prey.」

282:t_2:20.en:
$$オズマ$$
「From now on, whenever we engage them, we have no choice but to pull back anyone who is incapacitated.」

282:t_2:21.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Preferably, I'd rather never see them again, though.」

282:t_2:22.en:
$$赤木$$
「But those guys... will they come back again?」

282:t_2:23.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I cannot say either way at this point. It may be that they simply wandered into this solar system by some accident, and...」

282:t_2:24.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「They may also be a scouting party sent ahead of their main force.」

282:t_2:25.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「With no effective tactics against ELS erosion at present, if a large force of them attacked, it would truly be a crisis for all humanity.」

282:t_2:28.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Either way, we don't have enough data at this point.」

282:t_2:29.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All we can do now is pray that they never show up again.」

282:t_2:30.en:
$$リンダ$$
「However, we will send the ELS data to every facility in the Jupiter region and call for vigilance.」

282:t_2:31.en:
$$リンダ$$
「On top of that, we will observe the movements of the $$バアル$$, including the ELS, from this position.」

282:t_2:33.en:
$$リンダ$$
「It's all right, $$ミレイナ$$. Besides, you all have to return to Earth, tell people about this, and then fight the Empire.」

282:t_2:34.en:
$$イアン$$
「That's right. ...There was that accident, but resupply of every ship will be finished soon.」

282:t_2:35.en:
$$ブライト$$
「After that, each ship of $c will return to the $$地球圏$$ by way of Mars.」

282:t_2:36.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All hands, prepare to set sail. We leave this base in 24 hours.」

282:t_2:38.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Jumping to conclusions like that isn't good, you know.」

282:t_2:39.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Some guys look so delicate you'd think they were girls, but underneath they're a bundle of fighting instinct.」

282:t_2:41.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Um, $$アルト$$... There's something I've been thinking.」

282:t_2:42.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Even the $$バジュラ$$ fought humans at first, when nobody could tell what they were thinking, but in the end we were able to get our feelings across.」

282:t_2:43.en:
$$ランカ$$
「So maybe we can do the same with those creatures, the ELS... is what I think.」

282:t_2:44.en:
$$アルト$$
「You mean we should let those guys hear a song?」

282:t_2:45.en:
$$シェリル$$
「That's not it. It's just that there might be some way to get our feelings across, that's all.」

282:t_2:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'd like to get in on that plan myself.」

282:t_2:49.en:
$$アルト$$
「W-Well, yes... If it were $$バサラ$$, sure, but...」

282:t_2:50.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I don't think that creature, the ELS... is $$バアル$$.」

282:t_2:52.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't sense the urge to destroy from them that I sensed from the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ or the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s. Instead, I sense something like a will.」

282:t_2:53.en:
$$アルト$$
「You mean they're acting with a clear will of their own?」

282:t_2:54.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't ask me what it is... It's just something like a hunch of mine.」

282:t_2:55.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I think it's worth trying.」

282:t_2:56.en:
$$アルト$$
「...Understood. I'll pass it on to everyone.」

282:t_2:57.en:
$$シェリル$$
「That kind of positivity... I don't dislike it.」

282:t_2:59.en:
$$アルト$$
「First things first, though: getting ready to set sail. Our next destination is Mars, remember.」

282:t_2:62.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Did you also think it was odd for me to say something like that?」

282:t_2:64.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You felt something from that ELS too, didn't you?」

282:t_2:66.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...$$刹那$$. Do you remember 《$$リボンズ$$》 Almark?」

282:t_2:68.en:
$$アムロ$$
「When I was with him, we held all sorts of discussions, and one time we talked about this...」

282:t_2:69.en:
$$アムロ$$
「When humanity meets an alien species we can't talk to, by what means should we communicate...」

282:t_2:71.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't know what he intended by bringing that up.」

282:t_2:72.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But it's certain that man had delved to a considerable depth into $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$'s plan as well.」

282:t_2:74.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The $$ダブルオークアンタ$$... I believe in that machine's potential.」

282:t_2:76.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe it's because I saw the galaxy with my own eyes... I feel that someday humanity will surely make that entire vast space its home.」

282:t_2:77.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Perhaps what we're meant to do is find a way to live there...」

282:t_2:79.en:
$$刹那$$
「I don't know what was on $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$'s mind while waiting for the $$イノベイター$$ to awaken...」

282:t_2:80.en:
$$刹那$$
「But if there is something this power can do, then I will carve out the future together with the $$ダブルオークアンタ$$.」

282:t_2:82.en:
$$アムロ$$
(I'm sure that's the role meant for me and $$刹那$$...)

282:t_10:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$. I've got a little errand to run, so you'll have to excuse me.」

282:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, of course. A girlfriend far away must matter more than a dumpy thing like me~.」

282:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To go off without a hint of embarrassment...」

282:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... it can't be helped. She's the girlfriend he saved by snapping her death flag in two.」

282:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ロックオン$$, who fought hard in front of her... His high spirits produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

282:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A way of life that overturns fate... I'd like to learn from it myself.」

282:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, Miss $$ミレイナ$$! You've come at just the right time!」

282:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Would you lend your power to this pitiful $$ＡＧ$$ for a moment, Miss $$ミレイナ$$?」
